title: Replay: would you buy here?
hook: It's September 2007. You only see what traders saw then.
takeaway: A replay without hindsight: a leading stock built a six-week, 14%-deep base, then closed at a new high on 80% more volume than usual, with its RS line at a new high and the market showing one distribution day. Would you buy? The reveal is Lore 015.
learn: A base is a pause where the price moves sideways; this one lasted six weeks and was 14% deep.
A close at a new high on heavier volume than usual, with the RS line at a new high, is what a strong breakout looks like.
Check the market too: here the S&P 500 had only one distribution day, a calm count.

glossary.relative strength: the stock was beating the market

question: Would you buy here?
emotion: the itch of deciding with no hindsight, the way it actually feels
